title: Former soldier sees triangle take off at Area 51

tellings.quote: weirdly enough, I've talked to a guy who former uh army in the the mid 2010s who said he saw a a like a triangle craft jut off of an airway in Area 51.

plain: In the mid 2010s a former Army soldier says he saw a triangle-shaped craft shoot off from an airstrip at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says he spoke with this man, who is not named. It is told as a hint that such craft are flown or tested there.
